targets.query:
import "array"

_acRec     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "total_active_power")   |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_battRec   = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "battery_power")          |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_importRec = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "import_from_grid")       |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_exportRec = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "export_to_grid")         |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_wpRec     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heating" and r["_field"] == "electric_power_actual")   |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_trocknerRec     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307067395364351080248e1e9ceaeab" and r["property"] == "power") |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_waschmaschRec   = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307068416409851080248e1e9ceb390" and r["property"] == "power") |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_bambuRec        = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307145526576151080848e1e9d11e5e" and r["property"] == "power") |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
_arbeitstischRec = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307140501764051080848e1e9d123f7" and r["property"] == "power") |> mean() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
acPower    = if exists _acRec._value     then _acRec._value     else 0.0
battPower  = if exists _battRec._value   then _battRec._value   else 0.0
gridImport = if exists _importRec._value then _importRec._value else 0.0
gridExport = if exists _exportRec._value then _exportRec._value else 0.0
wpPower    = if exists _wpRec._value     then _wpRec._value * 1000.0 else 0.0
trocknerPower     = if exists _trocknerRec._value     then _trocknerRec._value     else 0.0
waschmaschPower   = if exists _waschmaschRec._value   then _waschmaschRec._value   else 0.0
bambuPower        = if exists _bambuRec._value        then _bambuRec._value        else 0.0
arbeitstischPower = if exists _arbeitstischRec._value then _arbeitstischRec._value else 0.0
merossTotal       = trocknerPower + waschmaschPower + bambuPower + arbeitstischPower

pvPower       = acPower - battPower
battDischarge = if battPower > 0.0 then battPower  else 0.0
battCharge    = if battPower < 0.0 then -battPower else 0.0

battToGrid  = if battDischarge < gridExport then battDischarge else gridExport
gridToBatt  = if battCharge    < gridImport then battCharge    else gridImport
pvToBatt    = battCharge    - gridToBatt
pvToGrid    = gridExport    - battToGrid
battToHouse = battDischarge - battToGrid
gridToHouse = gridImport    - gridToBatt
pvToHouse   = pvPower       - pvToBatt - pvToGrid

hausVerbrauch = pvToHouse + battToHouse + gridToHouse
wpShare       = if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then wpPower / hausVerbrauch else 0.0
wpShareCapped     = if wpShare > 1.0 then 1.0 else wpShare
remainingShare    = 1.0 - wpShareCapped
totalMerossShare  = if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then merossTotal / hausVerbrauch else 0.0
capFactor         = if totalMerossShare > remainingShare then remainingShare / totalMerossShare else 1.0
trocknerShare     = (if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then trocknerPower     / hausVerbrauch else 0.0) * capFactor
waschmaschShare   = (if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then waschmaschPower   / hausVerbrauch else 0.0) * capFactor
bambuShare        = (if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then bambuPower        / hausVerbrauch else 0.0) * capFactor
arbeitstischShare = (if hausVerbrauch > 0.0 then arbeitstischPower / hausVerbrauch else 0.0) * capFactor
sonstigesShare    = remainingShare - trocknerShare - waschmaschShare - bambuShare - arbeitstischShare

array.from(rows: [
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Wärmepumpe",    "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * wpShareCapped     > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * wpShareCapped     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Trockner",       "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * trocknerShare     > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * trocknerShare     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Waschmaschine",  "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * waschmaschShare   > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * waschmaschShare   else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "BambuLab P1S",   "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * bambuShare        > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * bambuShare        else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Arbeitstisch",   "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * arbeitstischShare > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * arbeitstischShare else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Sonstiges",       "Leistung (W)": if pvToHouse   * sonstigesShare    > 0.0 then pvToHouse   * sonstigesShare    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Heimspeicher",         "Leistung (W)": if pvToBatt    > 0.0 then pvToBatt    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "PV Solar",  Ziel: "Einspeisung",      "Leistung (W)": if pvToGrid    > 0.0 then pvToGrid    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Wärmepumpe",      "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * wpShareCapped     > 0.0 then battToHouse * wpShareCapped     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Trockner",         "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * trocknerShare     > 0.0 then battToHouse * trocknerShare     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Waschmaschine",    "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * waschmaschShare   > 0.0 then battToHouse * waschmaschShare   else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "BambuLab P1S",     "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * bambuShare        > 0.0 then battToHouse * bambuShare        else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Arbeitstisch",     "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * arbeitstischShare > 0.0 then battToHouse * arbeitstischShare else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Sonstiges",         "Leistung (W)": if battToHouse * sonstigesShare    > 0.0 then battToHouse * sonstigesShare    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Heimspeicher",  Ziel: "Einspeisung",       "Leistung (W)": if battToGrid  > 0.0 then battToGrid  else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Wärmepumpe",        "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * wpShareCapped     > 0.0 then gridToHouse * wpShareCapped     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Trockner",           "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * trocknerShare     > 0.0 then gridToHouse * trocknerShare     else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Waschmaschine",      "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * waschmaschShare   > 0.0 then gridToHouse * waschmaschShare   else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "BambuLab P1S",       "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * bambuShare        > 0.0 then gridToHouse * bambuShare        else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Arbeitstisch",       "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * arbeitstischShare > 0.0 then gridToHouse * arbeitstischShare else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Sonstiges",           "Leistung (W)": if gridToHouse * sonstigesShare    > 0.0 then gridToHouse * sonstigesShare    else 0.0},
  {Quelle: "Netz",      Ziel: "Heimspeicher",             "Leistung (W)": if gridToBatt  > 0.0 then gridToBatt  else 0.0},
])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "total_active_power" or r["_field"] == "battery_power" or r["_field"] == "export_power_hybrid" or r["_field"] == "load_power_hybrid")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      "PV Erzeugung":              r.total_active_power - r.battery_power,
      "Hausverbrauch":             r.load_power_hybrid,
      "Heimspeicher (+lädt/-entlädt)": r.battery_power,
      "Netz (+Einsp./-Bezug)":     r.export_power_hybrid
  }))
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heating" and r["_field"] == "electric_power_actual")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 1000.0, _field: "Wärmepumpe"}))
  |> yield(name: "mean")

trockner     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307067395364351080248e1e9ceaeab" and r["property"] == "power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Trockner"}))
waschmaschine = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307068416409851080248e1e9ceb390" and r["property"] == "power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Waschmaschine"}))
bambu         = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307145526576151080848e1e9d11e5e" and r["property"] == "power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "BambuLab P1S"}))
arbeitstisch  = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307140501764051080848e1e9d123f7" and r["property"] == "power") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Arbeitstisch"}))
union(tables: [trockner, waschmaschine, bambu, arbeitstisch])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: Energiebilanz kumuliert
panels.description: Kumulierte Energie seit Beginn des gewählten Zeitraums. Eigenversorgung = PV-Erzeugung + Heimspeicher-Entladung.

targets.query:
eigenversorgung = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and (r["_field"] == "total_active_power" or r["_field"] == "battery_power"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: (r.total_active_power + (if r.battery_power < 0.0 then -r.battery_power else 0.0)) * float(v: int(v: v.windowPeriod)) / 3600000000000000.0, _field: "Eigenversorgung"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> cumulativeSum()

netzbezug = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "import_from_grid")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: (if r._value > 0.0 then r._value else 0.0) * float(v: int(v: v.windowPeriod)) / 3600000000000000.0, _field: "Netzbezug"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> cumulativeSum()

hausverbrauch = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "load_power_hybrid")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * float(v: int(v: v.windowPeriod)) / 3600000000000000.0, _field: "Gesamtverbrauch"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> cumulativeSum()

union(tables: [eigenversorgung, netzbezug, hausverbrauch])
  |> yield(name: "cumulative")

panels.title: Verbrauchsanteile
panels.description: Mittlerer Leistungsanteil jedes Verbrauchers über den gewählten Zeitraum.

targets.query:
import "array"

durationH = float(v: int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 3600000000000.0

totalRec     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sungrow" and r["_field"] == "load_power_hybrid")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

wpRec        = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heating" and r["_field"] == "electric_power_actual")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

trocknerRec  = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307067395364351080248e1e9ceaeab" and r["property"] == "power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

waschmRec    = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307068416409851080248e1e9ceb390" and r["property"] == "power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

bambuRec     = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307145526576151080848e1e9d11e5e" and r["property"] == "power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

arbeitRec    = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meross" and r["device"] == "2307140501764051080848e1e9d123f7" and r["property"] == "power")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

wpKwh          = wpRec._value * durationH
trocknerKwh    = trocknerRec._value * durationH / 1000.0
waschmaschKwh  = waschmRec._value * durationH / 1000.0
bambuKwh       = bambuRec._value * durationH / 1000.0
arbeitstischKwh = arbeitRec._value * durationH / 1000.0
totalKwh       = totalRec._value * durationH / 1000.0
knownKwh       = wpKwh + trocknerKwh + waschmaschKwh + bambuKwh + arbeitstischKwh
sonstigesKwh   = if totalKwh > knownKwh then totalKwh - knownKwh else 0.0

array.from(rows: [
  {_time: now(), _value: wpKwh,          _field: "Wärmepumpe"},
  {_time: now(), _value: trocknerKwh,    _field: "Trockner"},
  {_time: now(), _value: waschmaschKwh,  _field: "Waschmaschine"},
  {_time: now(), _value: bambuKwh,       _field: "BambuLab P1S"},
  {_time: now(), _value: arbeitstischKwh, _field: "Arbeitstisch"},
  {_time: now(), _value: sonstigesKwh,   _field: "Sonstiges"},
])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "shares")
